name: Hundegger ROBOT-Max
summary: Large mass-timber joinery machine: a 6-axis robot unit with a 32-tool changer and an overhead 5-axis saw machine glulam beams and columns up to 610 × 1,300 mm on all six sides in one pass. Built by Hundegger in Germany as the big brother of the ROBOT-Drive.

germany.statusNote: German maker; sold on request from Hawangen (Allgäu). No price published. Hundegger USA says the machine was developed for the North American mass-timber market, but the German product page offers it as a regular machine.

sellers.name: Hans Hundegger AG
sellers.note: Kemptener Straße 1, 87749 Hawangen, Germany. Price on request.

specs.label: Timber cross-section
specs.quote: Cross sections from 20 x 60 mm up to 610 x 1,300 mm

specs.label: Largest member (Hundegger USA)
specs.quote: The ROBOT-Max can process beams and columns as large as 24" x 48" and up to 40' long.

specs.label: Robot spindle
specs.quote: The Hundegger ROBOT MAX comes with a standard 29 kW - liquid cooled - variable speed from 0 to 15000 rpm

specs.label: 5-axis saw/slot/marking unit
specs.quote: The overhead 5-axis saw/slot/marking unit with a drive rating of 13 kW further increases the throughput of the ROBOT-Max

specs.label: Sides machined per pass
specs.quote: 6-axis technology = processing on 6 sides in a single pass

notes: Stationary machine; can stand on a base on the concrete floor with the chip disposal in a pit below the processing zone.
Automatic infeed separates and feeds members of mixed cross-sections; hydraulic lift table upstream.

images.alt: Hundegger ROBOT-Max joinery machine in a timber hall with a large glulam beam on the outfeed conveyor

evidence.task: Ordered for glulam beam and column production at two new mass-timber plants
evidence.where: SmartLam North America, Dothan (Alabama) and Columbia Falls (Montana), USA
evidence.note: Delivery schedule announcement by Hundegger USA; the Dothan glulam plant was expected to be fully operational by October 2024.

sources.title: Hundegger USA Announces Equipment Delivery Schedule for SmartLam North America Facilities (9 February 2023)

openQuestions: Are the SmartLam ROBOT-Max machines running? Only the 2023 delivery plan was read.
Any ROBOT-Max installed in Germany or the EU? None was found.
